Reliance Announces Major Investments in Andhra Pradesh and Bengal

Reliance Industries is planning significant investments in India. In Andhra Pradesh, the company will invest ₹1 lakh crore to establish Compressed Bio Gas (CBG) plants, a project expected to create 3 lakh jobs and generate ₹60,000 crore in state revenue. Separately, Reliance is planning a nuclear power project in Bengal, which could involve an investment of up to ₹2 lakh crore.
